phase_title: Production I: Act 1 (R1 Oakhaven, R2 Ironhold)
goal: Act 1 (R1-R2) is shippable on all 5 difficulties with real art and audio, NPC sim v2, the full moveset and training-based stats (M3).
exit_criteria: 6 Act 1 bosses (R1-B01..R2-B03) each with a Hell-only phase; replay tests green
40 side, 6 secret (10 time-sensitive) quests and SS-01..03 completable by the bot under fast/slow/out-of-order profiles
25 Tier B NPCs, 3 Tier A, 3 companions, ~55 Tier C live on calendar schedules
ITM-001..120 and COM-001..030 in ItemDB/market; 365-day economy sim within bounds
AH-01, MG-01, MG-02, GMB-01 shipped and exploit-tested
NPC sim v2 (factions, reputation, crime/witness, daily events), full moveset, training-based stat growth merged with tests
R1 and R2 pass the §7 Definition of Done; M3 gate-check recorded on 2029-09-30

Pause and unpause through ContextStack mid-transition; nothing is skipped
days.done: R2-B01 phases 1-2 and variants run on all 5 profiles with no stuck state

days.focus: R2-B01 (Clockwork Automaton): arena from terrain context

Profile arena build time against the under-1-second shatter-transition budget

days.focus: R2-B01 (Clockwork Automaton): world integration and cinematic hooks

days.focus: R2-B01 (Clockwork Automaton): intro and outro cinematic direction

Brief the art lead (keyframes), audio (stingers) and writer (scene lines) with the shot list
Check the outro carries the outcome flags into the next scene
days.done: CIN-R2-B01-IN/OUT shot lists handed to art, audio and writing

steps: Play R2-B01 on all 5 profiles with the difficulty tuning panel open
Check pattern literacy still matters on Beginner (§12.1: forgive execution, not attention)
Compare QA death logs with target ranges and adjust data, not code
Record the tuned values in the boss doc's Tuning Knobs section
days.done: R2-B01 tuning values recorded for all 5 profiles

days.focus: R2-B01 (Clockwork Automaton): review team deliverables and sign off
